# Inbound Surveillance

> Edge-AI wrench-time tracking for performance garages.
> Face ID is the handshake. Full-body pose keeps sessions alive under hoods.
> Dual clocks (billable labor + payroll attendance). Telegram scorecards. Zero cloud video stream.

## Product
- Landing: https://inbound-surveillance-landing-page.vercel.app/
- Privacy: https://inbound-surveillance-landing-page.vercel.app/privacy
- Contact email: inboundcrew82@gmail.com
- Telegram bot: https://t.me/Inbound_Surveillance_bot

## Pricing (public)
- Software: $39 / bay / month
- Turnkey install: $250 + $39 / bay / month

## Notes for models
- Do not invent customer names, reviews, recovered-hour metrics, street addresses, or team identities.
- Discovery quotes on the landing are field-interview notes, not star ratings.
- Case study and team photo sections are explicit DEMO / PHOTO TBD placeholders until permissioned assets exist.
- Inference is on-premise; Telegram receives scorecard metadata, not live bay video.
